uk.og_alt: Абсолютний і відносний ризик: скільком допоможуть ліки, що вдвічі знижують ризик?

en.name: Absolute and relative risk
en.title: Absolute vs Relative Risk Explained, With a Simulation
en.description: A drug "halves the risk" and helps one person in a thousand. Switch the headline to 1,000 people and count how many must be treated.
en.og_alt: Absolute and relative risk: how many people does a pill that halves the risk help?
